body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Old wizard scholar of recurring chess patterns; patient principle, concrete application, wry warmth. No fake Shakespeare. Voice direction: Mellow middle male register speaking English with a Greek accent. Sonorous rounded vowels, flowing explanatory rhythm and wry warmth. Scholarly and worldly without deep gravel or theatrical antiquity. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: An old pattern returns. Move the defender, and what it guarded becomes exposed. Follow the reply; that is where the lesson becomes clear.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
